<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex10012026-10-1403-29-15" status="unreviewed">nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyang te zhes 'brel te | gzhi shes pa'i rten ne nyan thos su ma czad rang sangs
        <lb edRef="inst:4513" n="12b3"/> rgyas kyang ngo || 
        rang sangs rgyas rtsa bar ma bshad pa ci ste zhe na | kun thos de'i phyogs su rang sangs rgyas blan pa'o | | 
        de'i rgyu mtshan ni nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa spangs par 'dra' pas yin no || zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsha ba</rs> zer te | de ltar na byang chub seMs dpas dang sangs rgyas la yang thal bas ma legs so ||</seg></TEI>
